verdict.rationale: Teller's own GitHub org (tellerhq) publishes a React hook and component for integrating Teller Connect. That is a first-party SDK, but it covers only the front-end enrollment widget. Nothing shows official server-side client libraries for the balances, transactions, identity or payments APIs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so there is no spec to generate clients from. missing for 10: official server-side SDKs for core API resources in major languages, SDK documentation and versioning, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
